No partial-seed ensemble; no seed/epoch retry or replacement model.
OOF_training.failure: Record failed attempt and actual completed count. Six is a hard fit ceiling, not six successful fits plus retries. Any operational resume preserving an exact unfinished trajectory requires a separate reviewed receipt; no automatic restart.

OOF_and_target_clock.prediction_rows: Only P1 input/timing rows with actual trade_date.year in2018..2022, including previous-year signal dates at year boundaries. No2023+ forward call.
OOF_and_target_clock.routing: Use actual trade_date.year, never signal_date.year. Each year uses its three states seed=base_seed+year; exact equal-weight ensemble of the five original outputs, normalize three weights as original _ensemble.
OOF_and_target_clock.prediction_clock: Raw allocation outputs use prior-session features at original decision_at09:29NY.
OOF_and_target_clock.target_algorithm: Preserve original _smooth_weights EMA/span and threshold/spec/candidate, applied once over the full chronological admitted2018..2022 OOF sequence with no annual reset. Warm smoothing from the first supported2018 trade row before physical shadow start; initial virtual weights are original CASH. Original PGH1 arrays remain unchanged.
OOF_and_target_clock.target_clock: The smoothed target is consumed at09:46NY. Its virtual holding update from a previous H1 return is admitted only after that original return_available_at (normally current09:31). The current/future H1 may not affect its own decision. Implement chronologically and assert every used return clock<=current09:46; do not claim the whole smoothed target existed at09:29.
OOF_and_target_clock.risk_target: At09:46 pass smoothed weights and original ensemble probabilities to prepare_on_policy_open(model=None), with only the common raw shadow state marked at known09:45. Original nonlearned risk state/projection/mandatory guards; no composition transform, no common cross-cost cap, no learned opening or recovery controller.

nonlearned_policy_identity.use_scope: Only existing deterministic prepare_on_policy_open/guard fields. The legacy10/25bp spec fields do not set shadow/branch costs; only the inherited Tiered tariff plus2bp does. No learned controller or historical policy-selection independence is claimed.

common_training_shadow.last_trade_date_rule: Last P1 PG-supported trade date, without source extension. A final valuation at its native exit date within2022 is allowed; absence of a next target still forbids that row label.
common_training_shadow.ownership: One continuously owned physical account: integer SOXL/SOXX quantities, spendable cash, receivables, applied event IDs, fee month counters, NAV/peak, prior-known NAV/history, risk_state/risk_clock. No annual reset and no branch writes back into teacher.
sequence: Apply that day qualified split/ex/pay events once before known09:45; unpaid receivable contributes toNAV but cannot fund buys.
At known09:45 mark raw holdings+cash+receivable; update peak/history and call original deterministic opening preparation for09:46.
Settle the always-execute desired risk-projected target at raw09:47 using IncomeLedger/settle_raw/TieredFees; sell before buy and retain original affordability/integer rules.
No learned or discretionary10:32 order; preserve10:32 mark and exchange-schedule actual close. Update close peak using that close only.
Next session applies its own events before known/entry marks; persist complete teacher ledger and immutable per-decision prebranch state/target.
common_training_shadow.missing: Preserve every prescribed shadow session. Missing required mark or corporate unit/order ambiguity stops the continuous shadow, never silently jumps dates. A missing prefix alone only sets mask0 and does not stop shadow or discard a valid label.
common_training_shadow.implementation_boundary: A narrow training-mode adapter may reuse existing physical primitives and output schema; do not invoke replay_stage1_raw unchanged because it requires a fitted opening controller. Do not invoke replay_raw_package because it applies composition/cross-cost transforms. Sealed helpers/cards remain unchanged.
common_training_shadow.native_authority: One native_raw_validate replay of this exact prescribed order path with original frozen reconciliation tolerances and dividend/split cash conservation. Validation certifies the training shadow ledger, not alpha or a candidate account.

local_action_labels.eligibility: Original opening guards: no mandatory_derisk, no large_transition, no mandatory_position_repair; original22 feature values finite. No fitted execute probability required in the teacher. Record all days and explicit reasons; availability of prefix is not eligibility.
local_action_labels.state_and_entry: For each eligible row with a valid next common target/marks, deep-clone the same pre-order physical quantities, spendable cash, IncomeLedger receivables/applied IDs and TieredFees monthly counters. At current09:47 EXECUTE submits current desired target; HOLD submits no order.
local_action_labels.interval: No intervening learned recovery. Each branch applies the same scheduled corporate events exactly once to its own actual holdings/cash. Preserve own fee tier usage, dividend amounts and spendable-cash constraints.
local_action_labels.reset: At next common teacher09:46 the reset target weights are fixed by the teacher, not either counterfactual branch. Both branches reset to these same weights at next raw09:47. Quantity/cash/NAV and reset cost may differ. No reset-day opening order is omitted from either branch.
local_action_labels.definition: Delta=(post-reset NAV_EXECUTE - post-reset NAV_HOLD) / common pre-order NAV valued at current raw09:47, including receivables. Denominator/fills and subsequent target are label-only, never current decision inputs. This local fixed-reset contrast is not the value of a recursively altered strategy.
local_action_labels.maturity: max(next teacher target informationtime09:46, next right-edge09:48 bar completion plus60s)=next09:49NY under the pinned research clock; require strictly before the intended fitting cutoff. A later actual dependency shifts maturity forward, never earlier.
local_action_labels.missing: PG final missing next target stays NaN/unknown, even when exit prices exist. No mixed2023+frame, synthesized target or zero-filled label. Missing prefix retains NaN A/control values andmask0 while a valid local label remains usable.
local_action_labels.budget: At most one EXECUTE/HOLD pair per eligible row on the original PG-supported shadow grid; no alternative windows, costs or branch targets. No full native account per branch.
local_action_labels.legacy_helper: tiered_action_labels.reset_advantage is a conceptual/zero-corporate unit1 reference only: it lacks physical corporate accounting. Do not load its old labels or force corporate-event equality to that obsolete convention.

fixed_path_inputs.grid: P0=09:31.open (bar starts09:30); fifteen closes09:31..09:45 on both ETFs, all closed by09:45 and known09:46. No09:46close or afternoon completeness in mask.
fixed_path_inputs.coordinates: x=SOXX price/P0-1; y=SOXL price/P0-1; fixed orientation and rawNONE minute plane.
fixed_path_inputs.arithmetic: Widen frozen float32 native values tofloat64 before division. Sequential j=1..15 left-fold accumulation, A=0.5*sum(x[j-1]*dy[j]-y[j-1]*dx[j]); same sequential order for Qx=sum(dx^2),Qxy=sum(dx*dy),Qy=sum(dy^2). No compensation/order/precision/window alternatives or outcome-based tolerance.
fixed_path_inputs.mask: P1 prefix-only coverage with both assets; unknown canonical A/eight controls remainNaN, mask0. No zero substitution in canonical data.
fixed_path_inputs.future_pairing: Later B/C would share original22 inputs+same8 controls+same mask and same nominal area slot: B neutral0, C signedA. All model encoding/scaling is deferred to P3. No abs(A), sign selection, volatility normalization or A×direction.
fixed_path_inputs.numerical_failure: Nonfinite values from an otherwise declared-valid positive prefix are a mechanical failure with receipt; do not select new arithmetic after viewing A. Constant/near-zero/endpoint-related outputs are reported, not used to tune thresholds or claim alpha.
